title: Transport of affine structural comparisons through pullback symmetry
statement: Let f:X→S be quasi-compact and separated [def-pc-scheme], E quasi-coherent [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module]. Suppose a family of Γ(T,O_T)-linear equivalences from H¹(X×_S T,pr_X^*O_X) to Γ(T,g^*E) for every affine g:T→S is natural for the coherent edge restriction [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-affine-base-change-edge-naturality]. Then there is an additive comparison family on the oppositely ordered fibre products T×_S X, with coefficient pr_X^*O_X, that is semilinear for pr_T and natural for the etale tensor-section restriction [def-weil-pbc-affine-cohomology-comparison-data]. This asserts only an ordinary coherent cohomology comparison, not an etale higher-image realization.

proof.text: Construct the additive comparison by composing the explicit unitAffineSymmetry with the given affine linear equivalence. Its scalar equation follows from unitAffineSymmetry_smul and linearity of e. The canonical naturality lemma supplies the restriction square for this exact family.

theorem exists_unitAffineComparisonTransport {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f] (E : S.Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent]
    (e : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (g : T ⟶ S) (_ : IsAffine T),
      coherentEdgeH f (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) g ≃ₗ[Γ(T, ⊤)]
        (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor T.toRingedSpace).obj
          ((tensorPullback g).obj E))
    (e_natural : ∀ (T T' : Scheme.{u}) (g : T ⟶ S) (h : T' ⟶ T)
      (hT : IsAffine T) (hT' : IsAffine T')
      (x : coherentEdgeH f (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) g),
      e T' (h ≫ g) hT' (coherentEdgePullback f
        (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) g h x) =
      coherentEdgeRho g h E (e T g hT x)) :
    ∃ c : ∀ (V : S.Etale) [IsAffine V.left],
      (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (Limits.pullback V.hom f).toRingedSpace 1).obj
        (affineRealizationCoefficient f (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) V) ≃+
          Γ((tensorPullback V.hom).obj E, ⊤),
      (∀ (V : S.Etale) [IsAffine V.left] (a : Γ(V.left, ⊤))
        (x : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (Limits.pullback V.hom f).toRingedSpace 1).obj
          (affineRealizationCoefficient f (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) V)),
        c V ((pullback.fst V.hom f).appTop a • x) = a • c V x) ∧
      (∀ (V V' : S.Etale) [IsAffine V.left] [IsAffine V'.left] (h : V' ⟶ V)
        (x : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (Limits.pullback V.hom f).toRingedSpace 1).obj
          (affineRealizationCoefficient f (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) V)),
        c V' (affineRealizationRestriction f (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) 1 h x) =
          etaleTensorSectionsRestriction E h (c V x))
